results.title: Less is more? A systematic review and network meta-analysis on ...
results.content: To this end, the current study aims to systematically review and conduct a network meta-analysis of studies comparing post-test item analysis metrics, such as item difficulty, discrimination index, and distractor functionality, among MCQs constructed with three, four, and five options. Two authors independently carried out the literature search and extracted the following details: study ID, study design, educational level and number of students, details of MCQs (number of test items, and number of options), and outcome measures (difficulty index, discrimination index, reliability coefficients, students’ performance, and response time). Instead, our analysis emphasizes that psychometric indicators such as discrimination indices and reliability coefficients remained comparable across formats, supporting the measurement integrity of 3-option MCQs. This may also reflect the higher difficulty indices observed with 3-option MCQs in the present study, indicating that these test items tend to be easier.

results.content: To this end, the current study aims to systematically review and conduct a network meta-analysis of studies comparing post-test item analysis metrics, such as item difficulty, discrimination index, and distractor functionality, among MCQs constructed with three, four, and five options. Two authors independently carried out the literature search and extracted the following details: study ID, study design, educational level and number of students, details of MCQs (number of test items, and number of options), and outcome measures (difficulty index, discrimination index, reliability coefficients, students’ performance, and response time). Instead, our analysis emphasizes that psychometric indicators such as discrimination indices and reliability coefficients remained comparable across formats, supporting the measurement integrity of 3-option MCQs. This may also reflect the higher difficulty indices observed with 3-option MCQs in the present study, indicating that these test items tend to be easier.
